list.title: Blog
list.emptyText: Share an integration that worked or a lesson learned: your blog is ready.
list.formeHint: Authors you follow first, then the best rated recent posts.

article.signInToStar: Sign in to give a star
article.reportConfirm: Report this post to the moderation team? Two reports hide it until a decision.
article.hidden: This post is hidden until the team decides; it stays visible to you and to the team.
article.draft: Draft: nobody else can see this post.

comments.heading: Comments
comments.label: Your comment
comments.help: Markdown accepted, no HTML. 5,000 characters at most.
comments.hidden: Comment hidden until the team decides.

blog.title: {{handle}}'s blog
blog.suspended: This blog is suspended by the moderation team.

mine.title: My blog
mine.intro: You publish without prior review; the team may hide content afterwards.
mine.emptyText: Start with a draft: it stays private until you publish it.

follows.title: My follows
follows.intro: Posts by these authors come first in your For me feed.
follows.emptyText: Open a member's blog and choose Follow.

editor.title: Title
editor.summaryHelp: One or two sentences, shown in lists and in the RSS feed.
editor.contentHelp: Headings, lists, links, code blocks and images uploaded here. HTML is not rendered.
editor.publishAtHelp: Optional. A future date schedules the post; without a date it appears as soon as you publish.
editor.imageAltHelp: What the image shows, for readers who cannot see it.
editor.imageFile: Add an image to the text
editor.imageHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 2 MB at most. The image goes where the cursor is.
editor.imageAltMissing: Describe the image before adding it.
editor.coverHelp: Optional. It shows at the top of the article and in the lists. PNG, JPEG or WebP, 2 MB at most.

moderation.heading: Blog
moderation.blockConfirm: Block this content? It disappears from the feed, the blogs, the RSS feed and the newsletter, for its author too.
moderation.suspendConfirm: Suspend {{handle}}'s blog? Their posts disappear and they can no longer publish.
moderation.emptyText: Member reports will appear here, the most reported first.
